3NF means a lack of [[transitive dependency]]<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aAx_JoEDXQA&list=PLLGlmW7jT-nTr1ory9o2MgsOmmx2w8FB3&index=4</ref>

What this means is that any data in non-primary keys that depends on others should be moved into separate tables
